multi_entity_note: Two parties: Clear Capital (Company) and RadialSpark, LLC (Contractor).
processing_note: Invoices shall also include receipts or other supporting detail concerning related expenses within the billing cycle.

contract.document_name.rationale: The agreement names itself 'MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT'; the defined short form 'Agreement' is only part of it and later generic 'this Agreement' references are not the title.

contract.effective_date.rationale: 09/24/2018 is defined as the 'Effective Date'; the other occurrences are the defined-term label only.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The term continues until terminated under Paragraph 6; no expiration date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 11: governed by 'the laws of the Arizona'.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Evergreen term until terminated; no renewal term.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No non-renewal notice; the 15-day periods are termination/cure notices and 30 days is for rate changes.
